name: AgileTact
name_zh: 深圳聚触灵动技术有限公司
summary: AgileTact is a Shenzhen-based developer of tactile sensors and data-capture hardware for robots, grippers and dexterous hands. Its sensor portfolio covers single-point three-axis force sensing, distributed tactile arrays, whole-fingertip sensing and integrated fingertip/finger-pad devices. The official company introduction identifies Hong Kong-based AgileReach as its parent company.
